description: Validate CSV structure before ingesting it: RFC 4180-aware parse, ragged rows, column-count consistency against the header or an expected schema, duplicate headers, stray quotes and empty-cell counts. Deterministic — every issue cites its exact row number. Use this when an agent needs to structural lint: ragged rows, dupes, quoting issues. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_csv_validator
